findings.evidence: Step 7 unconditionally says to "run the same line from step 5 (same `<plan file>` exclusion)" and "diff the two literal paths". However, step 5 permits unavailable verification and an unborn-repository fallback that records only `git status --porcelain=v1 -uall`. Unavailable verification leaves no valid baseline to compare; the unborn fallback neither excludes the expected plan creation nor clearly determines which command step 7 should repeat.
findings.fix: Record the verification mode in step 5: full, status-only or unavailable. In step 7, repeat the fingerprint command only for full verification. For unborn repositories, use `git status --porcelain=v1 -uall -- . ":(exclude)<plan file>"` both before and after execution, retaining the stated content-verification limitation. If verification was unavailable or either capture fails, skip the baseline diff, report that limitation and continue with the plan-content review.
